name: How much do custom cabinets and finishes cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What drives the price of custom cabinetry in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood?
mainEntity.text: What drives the price of custom cabinetry in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinetry pricing in Los Angeles is driven by both design and production complexity. The biggest variables are total linear footage, cabinet construction method, wood species, door style, finish system, drawer quality, and hardware selection. Painted, glazed, or multi-step specialty finishes usually cost more because they require additional surface prep, priming, sanding, spraying, and curing. In high-end homes, inset doors, integrated lighting, appliance panels, and full-height built-ins also raise labor and fabrication time. Site conditions matter too: older homes may need leveling, scribing, and custom fitting that add cost. The best way to compare bids is to ask each shop what is included in the finish, whether sample approval is part of the price, and how installation is handled. A low estimate can hide exclusions for hardware, shipping, or touch-up work. For luxury cabinetry, the cheapest quote is often not the most complete one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinet pricing depends on cabinet size, material grade, finish type, hardware, joinery, and installation complexity. Painted and specialty finishes often cost more than simple stained or laminate options because of extra prep and labor. Luxury projects with inset doors, built-ins, and detailed millwork typically cost more than standard box cabinetry.
